info.name: Amoria : Circle of Trust 1 (The Unmarried Couple)

descriptions.notStarted: An unhappy couple in Amoria? I should go find out what's wrong...
descriptions.inProgress: I spoke with Gary and Shatima, and it looks like their rings were broken and taken in to #b20 Ring Fragments#k by some Tweeters. Looks like I'll have to clip some wings to find them all...
descriptions.completed: I returned to the Rings to Gary and Shatima, and now they can get married! Phew, a lot of work, but well worth it!
